It does not establish external production behavior, generalized capability, Candidate activation, AGI, upper-objective achievement, or user-level completion.

next: After exact-head publication and remote-main readback of this Learn lifecycle, return to Root and select a materially different safe evidence-producing unit. reason: The episode confirms the existing three-clock fail-closed continuation contract, exactly-once request preservation, isolated one-guard fail-open controls, deterministic replay, and strict separation between bounded unit PASS and upper-objective FAIL. These lessons are already represented by current runtime contracts and the existing Task Evaluate Candidate. The frozen evidence supplies no distinct reversible prompt change, independent external capability result, or activation basis, so no new Candidate is justified.
retained_learning: A stale heartbeat is one stop-proof input, never sufficient proof by itself; dispatch must jointly bind heartbeat freshness, authoritative main/state/fence, and inbox revision at the safe boundary.
A rejected continuation must preserve the exact frozen request identity, repair only the concrete cause, and resume exactly once to one response and one successor.
One-disabled-guard fail-open controls are informative negative evidence only when isolated from live authority and paired with byte-stable protected replay.
Protected synthetic replay can validate guard behavior but cannot establish generalized capability, production behavior, autonomy, continual learning, AGI, or user-level completion.
Candidate activation, provider or production routing, unit verdict, task and user verdicts, upper-objective verdict, and AGI claim support are separate claims.
Request-time provenance is immutable: later workflow, CI, PR, merge, readback, or user-input facts belong to subsequent safe boundaries and must not be backfilled.
